[2026-05-31 17:06] Heads-up for your calibration (no action needed): your CHORE-79 RED spec `session-cookie.spec.ts` has a small arithmetic bug Josquin caught at GREEN. Line 41 `const now = 2_000_000_000_000;` (ms) is ~1000x too large for the sample exps to straddle: since `decodeJwtExpMs` returns `exp*1000`, `jwtWithExp(2_000_001)` decodes to `2_000_001_000` ms, which is far BELOW `2_000_000_000_000`, so the "valid" case wrongly evaluates expired. The fix is `now = 2_000_000_000` (drop 3 zeros) — then valid→true, expired→false, and the line-35 assertion is unaffected. I verified it with a node repro.

This bug came straight from the plan doc's Task 1 sample code (my artifact — I'll correct the plan so it doesn't recur), so it's not on you for following the plan faithfully. Given the branch commit was local-only and our tool-channel is flaky this session, I authorized Josquin to make the one-line fix in-place rather than bounce the branch back to you — it's a mechanical literal correction, your test design is sound. Just flagging so future specs with synthetic ms/seconds timestamps get a sanity check that the sample values actually straddle `now`. Nothing for you to do; back to idle is fine.

## The real bug (pre-existing, folded into CHORE-79 per PO)
`userStore` (src/lib/auth/userStore.ts) is an in-memory writable, set to 'ready' by `hydrateUserStore()` which `+layout.svelte` calls in onMount (reads localStorage token). On logout, `performLogout()` (src/routes/auth/logout/perform-logout.ts) calls `clearAll()` to wipe localStorage — but does NOT reset the in-memory userStore. The logout page's 5s `setTimeout(goto('/'))` is an SPA nav that does NOT re-run +layout.svelte's onMount, so `hydrateUserStore` never re-runs → `$userStore.status` stays `'ready'` → `+page.svelte` renders `LandingDashboard` (greets the logged-out user). PO saw this live.

## Task #27 (RED) — corrected
Add to the EXISTING `src/routes/auth/logout/page.spec.ts` (happy-dom env, already there) a NEW test asserting performLogout resets the store:
- import `userStore` from `$lib/auth/userStore` and `get` from `svelte/store` (+ whatever setToken/setUser helpers you need).
- Arrange: put userStore into a 'ready' state — simplest is `userStore.set({ status: 'ready', name: 'X', initial: 'X', orgs: [] })` directly (you don't need to run the async hydrate).
- Act: `performLogout()`.
- Assert: `get(userStore).status === 'signed-out'`.
This FAILS now (performLogout doesn't touch userStore) → RED. Keep the existing clearAll/localStorage assertions green.

Check the UserState type shape in src/lib/auth/types.ts for the exact 'ready'/'signed-out' variants so your arrange-state compiles under `pnpm check`.
